#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate report.pdf (body) and cover.pdf (cover page) using raw PDF syntax."""
from datetime import date

WIDTH, HEIGHT = 612.0, 792.0  # US Letter
MARGIN = 72.0


def esc(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_pdf(path, pages):
    """pages: list of dicts with 'items' = list of (x, y, size, font, text) tuples."""
    objects = []
    object_num = {}
    content_ids = []

    # Build content streams and page objects
    page_objs = []  # (page_num, content_num)

    next_num = 1
    catalog_num = next_num; next_num += 1
    pages_root_num = next_num; next_num += 1
    helv_num = next_num; next_num += 1
    helv_bold_num = next_num; next_num += 1

    for page in pages:
        content_num = next_num; next_num += 1
        content_ids.append(content_num)
        stream = []
        for (x, y, size, font, text) in page["items"]:
            fname = "F1" if font == "Helvetica" else "F2"
            stream.append("BT /%s %s Tf %s %s Td (%s) Tj ET" % (
                fname, size, x, y, esc(text)))
        content_body = b"".join(
            [b"stream\n", "\n".join(stream).encode("latin-1"), b"\nendstream"])
        page_num = next_num; next_num += 1
        page_objs.append((page_num, content_num))

    num_objects = next_num - 1

    kids = " ".join("[%d 0 R]" % p for p, _ in page_objs)
    pages_body = "<< /Type /Pages /Kids %s /Count %d >>" % (kids, len(page_objs))

    bodies = {}
    bodies[catalog_num] = "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages %d 0 R >>" % pages_root_num
    bodies[pages_root_num] = pages_body
    bodies[helv_num] = "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>"
    bodies[helv_bold_num] = "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>"

    for page_num, content_num in page_objs:
        page_body = ("<< /Type /Page /Parent %d 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 %s %s] "
                     "/Resources << /Font << /F1 %d 0 R /F2 %d 0 R >> >> "
                     "/Contents %d 0 R >>") % (
            pages_root_num, WIDTH, HEIGHT, helv_num, helv_bold_num, content_num)
        bodies[page_num] = page_body

    for i, (_, content_num) in enumerate(page_objs):
        bodies[content_num] = content_body

    data = bytearray()
    offsets = {}
    for n in range(1, num_objects + 1):
        body = bodies[n]
        offsets[n] = len(data)
        if isinstance(body, bytes):
            data += b"%d 0 obj\n" % n
            data += body
            data += b"\nendobj\n"
        else:
            data += ("%d 0 obj\n%s\nendobj\n" % (n, body)).encode("latin-1")

    xref_offset = len(data)
    xref = b"xref\n0 %d\n" % (num_objects + 1)
    xref += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for n in range(1, num_objects + 1):
        xref += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets[n]).encode("ascii")

    trailer = b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF" % (
        num_objects + 1, catalog_num, xref_offset)

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
        f.write(data)
        f.write(xref)
        f.write(trailer)


def center_text(page_items, text, y, size, font, page_width=WIDTH):
    w = 0.5 * size * len(text)
    x = (page_width - w) / 2
    page_items.append((x, y, size, font, text))


def build_cover():
    items = []
    today = date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %-d, %Y")

    center_text(items, "Annual Financial Report", 380, 36, "Helvetica-Bold")
    center_text(items, "Fiscal Year 2026", 330, 16, "Helvetica")
    center_text(items, date_str, 250, 20, "Helvetica")
    center_text(items, "Prepared by the Finance Department", 200, 12, "Helvetica")
    return [{"items": items}]


def build_body():
    pages = []
    today = date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %-d, %Y")

    content = [
        ("Introduction", [
            "This Annual Financial Report summarizes the financial performance and position of the",
            "organization for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. The report includes the statement",
            "of financial position, the statement of activities, and the statement of cash flows,",
            "along with accompanying notes and management's discussion and analysis.",
        ]),
        ("Financial Highlights", [
            "Total revenues for the fiscal year were $12.4 million, an increase of 6.2% over the",
            "prior year. Total expenses were $11.1 million, resulting in a surplus of $1.3 million.",
            "Cash and cash equivalents at year-end totaled $3.8 million. Long-term debt was reduced",
            "by $450,000 during the year.",
        ]),
        ("Statement of Financial Position", [
            "Assets: Cash and equivalents $3,800,000; Accounts receivable $1,250,000; Investments",
            "$4,600,000; Property and equipment, net $6,900,000. Total assets $16,550,000.",
            "",
            "Liabilities: Accounts payable $980,000; Accrued expenses $420,000; Long-term debt",
            "$3,150,000. Total liabilities $4,550,000.",
            "",
            "Net assets: Unrestricted $9,200,000; Temporarily restricted $2,800,000. Total net",
            "assets $12,000,000. Total liabilities and net assets $16,550,000.",
        ]),
        ("Statement of Activities", [
            "Revenues: Contributions $6,100,000; Program fees $4,200,000; Investment income",
            "$1,250,000; Other $850,000. Total revenues $12,400,000.",
            "",
            "Expenses: Program services $8,400,000; Management and general $1,700,000;",
            "Fundraising $1,000,000. Total expenses $11,100,000.",
            "",
            "Change in net assets: $1,300,000.",
        ]),
        ("Notes to the Financial Statements", [
            "Note 1 - Summary of Significant Accounting Policies: The financial statements are",
            "prepared on the accrual basis of accounting in accordance with generally accepted",
            "accounting principles (GAAP).",
            "",
            "Note 2 - Subsequent Events: Management has evaluated subsequent events through the",
            "date of this report. No material subsequent events were identified.",
        ]),
        ("Management's Discussion and Analysis", [
            "The organization finished the fiscal year with a healthy operating surplus. Revenue",
            "growth was driven by increased program fees and strong investment performance. The",
            "organization remains well positioned to continue its mission in the coming year.",
            "",
            "This report is unaudited and provided for internal planning purposes.",
        ]),
    ]

    def add_page(title, paragraphs):
        items = []
        y = HEIGHT - MARGIN
        items.append((MARGIN, y, 18, "Helvetica-Bold", title))
        y -= 34
        for para in paragraphs:
            if para == "":
                y -= 12
                continue
            words = para.split()
            line = ""
            for w in words:
                trial = (line + " " + w).strip()
                if 0.5 * 11 * len(trial) > (WIDTH - 2 * MARGIN):
                    items.append((MARGIN, y, 11, "Helvetica", line))
                    y -= 15
                    line = w
                else:
                    line = trial
            if line:
                items.append((MARGIN, y, 11, "Helvetica", line))
                y -= 15
            y -= 10
        items.append((MARGIN, 40, 9, "Helvetica", "Annual Financial Report - %s" % date_str))
        return {"items": items}

    for title, paras in content:
        pages.append(add_page(title, paras))
    return pages


if __name__ == "__main__":
    build_pdf("cover.pdf", build_cover())
    build_pdf("report.pdf", build_body())
    print("Generated cover.pdf and report.pdf")
PYEOF
